node.body:
With the ongoing war and a highly volatile Vix and oil market, I continue to urge caution.

The rebound yesterday was mostly in the badly beaten up stocks and there may well be opportunity in a rebound rally, though I doubt it is a high quality rally.

Our breakout scanner continues to highlight every move for you. Check out the new rotation tracker and you may see why I am cautious.
